title: Fair Market Baseline — Individual Loan Sanction Letter

fairClauses.title: Transparent Interest & Zero Foreclosure Charges
fairClauses.text: Floating interest rate resets are communicated in advance. No prepayment or foreclosure penalty shall apply to individual floating rate loans.

fairClauses.title: Prior Notice for Term Changes
fairClauses.text: Lender agrees to provide 30 days written notice before altering interest rates or fees.
